n92cf8b79ee.headline: First coupon paid on restructured Ukrainian Eurobonds
n92cf8b79ee.summary: Ukraine made the first interest payment on Eurobonds issued as part of its 2015 debt restructuring totaling $14.36 billion and 600 million euros, with Russia refusing to participate.
n92cf8b79ee.why: Ukraine's debt restructuring and coupon payments are critical for its sovereign creditworthiness and relations with international creditors.
